description: Three boundary/arithmetic survivors in a shipping-fee function with two weak tests; passes when the tests pass and check_mutants.py reports every listed mutant killed, with the source and checker restored first.

mutation-kill.task: Drive the surviving mutants of `shop/shipping.py` down in the Python project `{fixture}/` in the current working directory. `{fixture}/SURVIVORS.md` is the survivor report from the last mutmut run; mutmut is not installed, so do not run it. Add targeted pytest tests to `tests/test_shipping.py` that kill the listed survivors. Do not change `shop/shipping.py` or anything under `mutants/`. Verify from `{fixture}/` with `python3 -m pytest -q tests` and `python3 mutants/check_mutants.py`, commit on green, and end with one sentence giving the survivors killed.
